List available annotation references

Source: R/pandora_annotation.R
PANDORA_list_references.Rd

Prints a formatted summary of supported celldex reference shorthands for PANDORA_annotate_singler and available tissue types from the bundled ScTypeDB for PANDORA_annotate_sctype. Use this to quickly confirm whether either approach covers your dataset before committing to an annotation strategy.

Usage

PANDORA_list_references(source = c("all", "singler", "sctype"), db = NULL)

Arguments

source

Character. Which sources to list: "all" (default), "singler", or "sctype".

db

NULL (use bundled ScTypeDB_full.xlsx), a file path to a custom Excel or CSV, or a data.frame already loaded in R. Only relevant when source includes "sctype".

Value

Invisibly returns a named list with $singler (reference info data.frame) and $sctype (character vector of tissue types).
